slice-tier.title: Which builder tier builds this work item

question.instructions: Pick the smallest builder tier that can build this work item. The state is how much the work item holds and whether that fits each tier's sizing limits.

criteria.small: A haiku-class builder. The work item fits the small limits.
criteria.medium: A mid-size builder. The work item fits the medium limits.
criteria.large: The largest builder. The work item is bigger than the medium limits.

inputs.work-item.criteria: acceptance criteria in the work item
inputs.work-item.files: distinct paths the work item names
inputs.work-item.words: words in the body outside headings
inputs.work-item.fits_small: whether it is within the small tier's limits
inputs.work-item.fits_medium: whether it is within the medium tier's limits

ship-skip.title: May this release skip the human gate

question.instructions: May this release pass the ship gate without a person approving it? The state is what the release would change.

criteria.true: An agent may pass the gate for this release.
criteria.false: A person approves the release at the gate.

inputs.release.files_changed: files changed since the serving release
inputs.release.app_changed: whether any file under the app directory changed

rows.note: Never, until someone adds a row above this one that says when.
